propositions: signing.py is at the 800 LOC hard cap with zero headroom; any new edit fails the module-size gate

The file can be split along existing call-graph seams into three modules: _signing_manifest.py (manifest vocabulary), _signing_hmac.py (symmetric HMAC scheme), and signing.py (dispatch/CLI), with acyclic import direction
Monkeypatch hazard: _baked_commit_sha is patched on the signing module in tests but must be re-anchored to rebar._signing_manifest after the split to avoid no-op patches and vacuous test passes
The 34 distinct signing module attributes and 9 imported names across src/tests/scripts must be re-exported with unchanged signatures to maintain the public API contract
The split reduces signing.py to 435 LOC with 365 lines of headroom, while keeping _signing_manifest.py (216 LOC) and _signing_hmac.py (276 LOC) within the 200-500 LOC target band
